input_scope: Clean HEAD snapshot plus two scoped trainer files; unrelated dirty probes excluded.

dispositions.F1: Added adapter disposal on replay exceptions; unreachable engine-adapter cycles are GC collectible, no unmanaged engine resource claim.
dispositions.F2: Centralized candidate health check. IR is validated on intermediate states; final literal true is safe only after that gate.
dispositions.F3: Intermediate liveness/sample checks intentionally bypassed with synthetic values; real winner checked if terminal and final admission checks actual finish/winner/count. Added clarifying comment.
dispositions.F4: Intended strict wall-budget censoring, even if a finishing call crosses limit; actual winner and seconds remain in report.
dispositions.F5: Reject terminal invalid winner; no unsupported draw scoring.
dispositions.F6: Sigmoid is bounded, but added explicit range validation and regressions.
dispositions.F7: Added per-attempt setup-fault report wrapper. Global input contract failures still reject command before attempts.

limitations: Engineering smoke only: two corrected ordered-matchup seed pairs, left perspective only; no independent strength, calibrated probability, card certification or overall completion claim.
Existing NnPolicy enumerator is reused on a disposable reconstruction; it is not a certified complete legal-action mask. Production NnPolicy.Choose remains unchanged and is not promoted.
Training observations are Greedy before-decision states; one-ply afterstates under the model have distribution shift even though input and encoder contracts agree.
Original four treatment failures are preserved and excluded from paired wins, never called losses. Isolation amendment used two new seeds; not a blinded rerun of the initial comparison.

Wall limits are checked between synchronous calls and include replay/validation. Over-budget finished attempts remain inadmissible. Fingerprints are change detectors, not proof that all hidden VM state is equal.

Raw binary, model, complete trace/fingerprint results and quality manifests remain local with public SHA256 bindings. Original tool binary was not retained; initial attempts bind recorded tool hash and raw output, not final-source rerun. Corrected attempts bind the final tool binary.
Known terminal wins/losses override sigmoid estimates; invalid terminal winners, nonfinite or out-of-range scores reject the attempt. First-index choice policy remains fixed, not learned.
The two immutable plan files retain their original CRLF bytes via exact-path Git attributes; their pre-execution SHA256 is preserved in the repository.
